initializationSensitivity.qualification: Numerical sensitivity at fixed fitted cell dispersions and on the same known development data; this is not statistical parameter uncertainty or biological validation.

verification.qualification: Analytic support bounds reconstructed in FP64 from individual cells, not directed-rounding interval certification or biological validation.
